title: Malicious Certificate Request with Alternate Name via Certify or Certipy
author: NTT Security - Ramine Etow
description: Detects the use of Certify.exe or Certipy to request a certificate with a specified Subject Alternative Name (SAN). This is a common technique (ESC1) used in AD CS abuse to impersonate other users, often high-privileged ones like Domain Admins, by embedding their identity in the SAN field of a certificate.
